# std/net
Standard library: Network operations
Run with: ailang run --caps Net <file>

## Types

  [2mNetwork error types[0m
  export type NetError =
    | Transport(string)      -- DNS, timeout, TLS, connection errors
    | DisallowedHost(string) -- Domain not in allowlist
    | InvalidHeader(string)  -- Blocked or malformed header
    | BodyTooLarge(string) deriving (Eq)   -- Response exceeds size limit

  [2mHTTP response with full metadata[0m
  export type HttpResponse = {
    status: int,                           -- HTTP status code (200, 404, etc.)
    headers: List[{name: string, value: string}], -- Response headers (preserved order)
    body: string,                          -- Response body as UTF-8 (lossy for binary payloads)
    bodyBytes: bytes,                      -- Response body as raw bytes (always exact)
    ok: bool                               -- true if status 200-299
  }

  [2mA parsed URL as a plain record for direct field access.[0m
  export type Url = {
    scheme: string,     -- "https"        ("" if the URL is scheme-relative)
    host: string,       -- "example.com"  (hostname only, no port, no brackets for IPv6)
    port: string,       -- "8443"         ("" when no explicit port)
    path: string,       -- "/a/b"         (percent-decoded)
    query: string,      -- "q=1&r=2"      (raw, still percent-encoded — feed to parseQuery)
    fragment: string    -- "frag"         (decoded; "" when absent)
  }

## Exports

  httpGet(string) -> string ! {Net}
    HTTP GET request (deprecated: use httpRequest for status codes/headers)

  httpPost(string, string) -> string ! {Net}
    HTTP POST request

  httpRequest(string, string, list[{ name: string, value: string }], string) -> Result[HttpResponse, NetError] ! {Net}
    HTTP request with custom headers and structured errors (v0.3.8+)

  httpRequestBytes(string, string, list[{ name: string, value: string }], bytes) -> Result[HttpResponse, NetError] ! {Net}
    HTTP request with raw bytes body (binary upload)

  urlEncode(string) -> string
    Percent-encode a string for use in a URL (path, query, fragment, or form value).

  urlEncodeForm(list[{ name: string, value: string }]) -> string
    Build an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body from {name,value} records.

  parseUrl(string) -> Result[Url, string]
    Parse an RFC-3986 URL into its components (scheme/host/port/path/query/fragment).

  parseQuery(string) -> list[{ name: string, value: string }]
    Parse a query string ("a=1&b=2") into order-preserving {name,value} pairs.

## Usage

  import std/net (httpGet)
  -- or --
  import std/net as Net
